responsibility: Defines the generic vector-lowering pass that breaks unsupported GIMPLE vector operations back into scalar or piecewise forms after vectorization or other vector-producing optimizations. It contains helpers for extracting/inserting elements, building per-lane operations, selecting fallback compute types from optab availability, rewriting vector expressions into gimplified statement sequences, cleaning up EH/CFG effects, and registers the veclower and veclower2 passes that ensure vector IR is reduced to forms the back end can expand.
